beats.text: Okay, quick question, what if one person could run an entire media company from a laptop?
Sounds crazy, but here is the thing, most of the history we get shifts marked as small,
a garage, a notebook, a single idea that nobody took seriously.
In 1969, a computer with less power than your phone landed a human on the moon.

beats.text: Think about that for a second.
So today, I am building something new in the public.
Every single day, someday it works, someday everything breaks.
And honestly, that's the fun part, if you are curious about history,
science and technology or just how the world really works,
so you are at the right place, stay tuned.
